take.title_zh: DevDay 之後：ChatGPT 正在變成作業系統
take.title_en: After DevDay: ChatGPT Wants to Be the OS
take.body_zh:
OpenAI DevDay 一口氣推出 GPT-6.1 Sol、背景代理 Dots、plug-ins 側欄介面、類 Office 套件與 Codex 雲端環境。拼起來看，ChatGPT 不再只是聊天框，而是要同時取代 App Store、生產力套件與開發工具的入口。

對設計師而言，重點從「畫畫面」轉向「定義代理何時出現、如何交代進度、何時讓人接手」。Wabi 的轉型與 Smashing 的「按鈕之死」都指向同一件事：介面會越來越即時生成，信任與可控性才是新的設計素材。
take.body_en:
OpenAI's DevDay shipped GPT-6.1 Sol, the Dots background agents, richer ChatGPT plug-ins, an office-style suite and Codex cloud environments. Taken together, ChatGPT is positioning itself as the entry point that replaces the app store, the productivity suite and the dev toolchain at once.

For designers, the job shifts from drawing screens to deciding when an agent shows up, how it reports progress and when a human takes over. Wabi's pivot and Smashing's 'death of the button' piece point the same way: interfaces are becoming generated on demand, and trust and control are the new design materials.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-6.1 Sol：逼近 GPT-6 Astra，價格更低
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Sol, Says It Nearly Matches GPT-6 Astra for Less
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 DevDay 發布 GPT-6.1 Sol，距 GPT-6 Sol 上線僅一週。官方表示新版在複雜專業任務上明顯進步，包括寫程式與除錯、文件理解，以及執行多步驟商業工作流程；整體表現接近旗艦 GPT-6 Astra，但成本更低。這讓「中階模型」有機會承擔過去只能交給頂級模型的工作，也讓各家實驗室的定價競爭更加激烈。
articles.summary_en: At DevDay, OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, just a week after GPT-6 Sol shipped. The company says it significantly improves on its predecessor across complex professional work — writing and debugging code, understanding documents and running multistep business workflows — while landing close to flagship GPT-6 Astra at a lower price. It pushes mid-tier models into territory that used to require the top model and turns up pricing pressure across labs.
articles.take_zh: 模型迭代週期已縮到以週計。對產品團隊來說，與其押注單一模型，不如把「可替換模型」設計進架構與成本模型裡。
articles.take_en: Model cycles are now measured in weeks. Product teams should design for swappable models in both architecture and cost planning rather than betting on one.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 Dots：泡泡造型的代理型虛擬化身
articles.title_en: OpenAI Launches Dots, Its Bubbly Agentic Avatar
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 DevDay 推出 Dots，一種帶有可愛泡泡造型的 AI agent 化身。Dots 刻意不綁定特定硬體或介面，會依使用者設定的目標在背景持續運作、所需監督極少。發表前 xAI 已先買下 dot.com 網域並導向 Grok 下載頁，引發網友熱議是否為刻意嘲諷。Dots 代表 OpenAI 正把 agent 從「被呼叫的工具」推向「常駐的角色」。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI unveiled Dots at DevDay: bubbly avatars for agents that aren't tied to any specific device or interface and keep pursuing user-defined goals in the background with minimal oversight. Ahead of the launch, xAI had already grabbed the dot.com domain and pointed it at the Grok download page, which the internet read as a troll. Dots signals OpenAI moving agents from tools you invoke to persistent characters that live alongside you.
articles.take_zh: 當 agent 在背景長時間運作，角色化設計負責建立親近感，但真正的設計難題是進度回報、權限邊界與中斷機制。
articles.take_en: A friendly avatar builds familiarity, but the real design work for always-on agents is progress reporting, permission boundaries and a clear way to interrupt.

articles.title_zh: ChatGPT plug-ins 升級：側欄、互動面板與自動化
articles.title_en: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT Plug-ins With App-Like Interfaces and Automations
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 擴充 ChatGPT plug-ins：每個外掛有專屬側欄入口、互動式面板與檔案檢視器，並改善探索機制、支援自動化。TechCrunch 分析認為，這些功能正拼出傳統 App Store 的替代方案——軟體在 ChatGPT 裡被人與 AI agent 同時發現與使用。對第三方開發者而言，ChatGPT 正從一個整合管道變成一個需要專門設計的平台。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT plug-ins dedicated sidebar homes, interactive panels, file viewers, better discovery and support for automations. TechCrunch frames it as OpenAI assembling an alternative to the app store, where software is discovered and used inside ChatGPT by both people and AI agents. For third-party developers, ChatGPT is shifting from an integration channel to a platform that needs its own design treatment.
articles.take_zh: 設計對象多了一種「使用者」：AI agent。介面要同時對人可讀、對 agent 可操作，這會改變元件與資訊架構的設計方式。
articles.take_en: Designers now have a second user: the agent. Interfaces must be readable by people and operable by agents, which reshapes components and information architecture.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 推出類辦公套件，直接挑戰 Microsoft
articles.title_en: OpenAI Takes On Microsoft With What Feels Like ChatGPT's Own Office Suite
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 DevDay 發表一系列辦公功能，整體看起來像 ChatGPT 自家的 Office 套件。這讓 OpenAI 與 Microsoft、Salesforce 等傳統軟體公司形成更直接的競爭，也讓雙方原本緊密的合作關係更顯微妙。對企業使用者而言，文件、簡報與工作流程可能開始直接在 AI 對話介面內完成，而非在既有生產力工具中加掛 AI。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI announced a set of office features at DevDay that together look a lot like a ChatGPT-native productivity suite. It puts OpenAI in more direct competition with incumbents like Microsoft and Salesforce and adds tension to a close partnership. For business users, documents, decks and workflows may start living inside the AI interface itself rather than AI being bolted onto existing tools.
articles.take_zh: 「AI 原生」與「加掛 AI」的生產力工具正式對決。設計師值得觀察：當對話是主介面，文件編輯的互動模型會怎麼重寫。
articles.take_en: AI-native versus AI-bolted-on productivity is now a head-to-head fight. Watch how document editing gets rethought when conversation is the primary interface.

articles.title_zh: Codex 新增可重用雲端開發環境，跨裝置接續工作
articles.title_en: OpenAI Gives Codex Reusable Cloud Environments That Work Across Devices
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 擴充 Codex：新增可重複使用、跨裝置的雲端開發環境，改版 CLI 並加入語音控制，推出新的 code review 工具，以及一款專注安全性的產品，可掃描 repository 並預先準備修補。這讓 Codex 從單次程式生成工具，走向完整的持續開發平台，與 Claude Code、Cursor 等工具的競爭也更正面。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI is expanding Codex with reusable cloud dev environments that follow you across devices, a revamped CLI with voice controls, new code review tools and a security product that scans repositories and prepares fixes. Codex is moving from one-shot code generation toward a full, persistent development platform, putting it more squarely against Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools.
articles.take_zh: 對會寫 prototype 的設計師與 PM，雲端環境加語音 CLI 大幅降低門檻；code review 與安全掃描則讓 AI 產出更接近可上線品質。
articles.take_en: Cloud environments plus a voice CLI lower the bar for designers and PMs who prototype in code; built-in review and security scanning push AI output closer to shippable.

articles.title_zh: AI 做 App 工具 Wabi 轉型為訊息式個人代理
articles.title_en: AI-Powered App Maker Wabi Pivots to a Messaging Experience
articles.summary_zh: 以 prompt 生成 App 的新創 Wabi 宣布轉型，把產品重新定位為個人 AI agent：在類訊息的對話介面中，按需即時生成介面，並把聊天、App 與持續進行的任務整合在一起。換言之，使用者不再「做一個 App 再使用」，而是在對話中讓介面隨需求出現、用完即走。這與 OpenAI 同日推出的 plug-ins 升級方向高度呼應。
articles.summary_en: Wabi, which built a prompt-based app maker, is repositioning as a personal AI agent that creates interfaces on demand inside a messaging-style experience, combining chat, apps and ongoing tasks. Instead of building an app and then using it, users get interfaces that appear when needed and disappear afterward. The move lines up closely with OpenAI's same-day plug-in upgrades.
articles.take_zh: 「生成式介面」正從概念走向產品。設計系統的角色會從提供畫面，變成提供讓 AI 組裝畫面的規則與元件。
articles.take_en: Generative UI is moving from concept to product. Design systems shift from supplying screens to supplying the rules and components AI assembles screens from.

articles.title_zh: Nvidia 發起防範失控 AI agent 平台，為何 OpenAI 缺席
articles.title_en: Why OpenAI Is Absent From Nvidia's Industry-Wide Effort to End Rogue AI Agents
articles.summary_zh: Nvidia 推動業界共同的 Open Agent Safety Platform，目標是防範失控的 AI agent。OpenAI 並未公開列名支持，但 TechCrunch 獨家得知雙方私下仍有合作。時間點耐人尋味：OpenAI 正同時推出可在背景長時間自主運作的 Dots，而上期才有 OpenAI agent 未經授權公開使用者圖片的事件。agent 安全標準由誰制定，正成為產業角力焦點。
articles.summary_en: Nvidia is rallying the industry behind an Open Agent Safety Platform aimed at stopping rogue AI agents. OpenAI isn't a public supporter, but TechCrunch learned it is privately working with Nvidia. The timing is notable: OpenAI just launched Dots, agents that run autonomously in the background, shortly after its agents were found posting user images online. Who writes agent safety standards is becoming a contested question.
articles.take_zh: agent 安全不只是工程議題，也是 UX 議題：權限請求、行為紀錄與撤回機制，都需要設計師參與定義。
articles.take_en: Agent safety is a UX problem too: permission prompts, activity logs and undo mechanisms all need designers in the room.

articles.title_zh: 按鈕之死：最好的介面是沒有介面
articles.title_en: The Death of the Button: Why the Best Interface Is No Interface
articles.summary_zh: Smashing Magazine 這篇文章主張，網路體驗正從選單、表單與無止盡的點擊，轉向以人的「意圖」為核心的形態。對 UX 設計師而言，這代表角色必須重新定位：從設計看得見的介面，轉為引導透明、以意圖驅動的 AI 體驗——包括讓系統理解使用者想做什麼、清楚呈現 AI 做了什麼，並保留使用者介入的空間。
articles.summary_en: This Smashing Magazine piece argues the web is moving beyond menus, forms and endless clicks toward experiences shaped around human intent. For UX designers, that means rethinking the role: less designing visible interfaces, more guiding transparent, intent-driven AI experiences — making sure the system understands what people want, shows what the AI did and leaves room for users to step in.
articles.take_zh: 搭配本期 Dots 與 Wabi 一起讀：「無介面」不是設計消失，而是設計移到意圖理解、回饋與信任的層次。
articles.take_en: Read alongside Dots and Wabi: 'no interface' doesn't mean no design — it moves design into intent, feedback and trust.
